[[Mallyx's Cruelty]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[spear]] obtained from the [[Citadel Chest]], which spawns after [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] is defeated in [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%) 
:Double [[adrenaline]] on hit (Chance: 10%) 
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as [[The Bloodspear]], [[Mallyx's Strife]], and [[Turep's Spear]].
